title: Prepending a Right Memory Move
statement: Let $K_0,B,P$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{orc}:\{0,1,2,3\}\to\{0,1\}^*\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be an oracle, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Let $st$ be a machine state whose 17 register values are all at most $B$, let $M:\mathbb Z\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a memory, let $p\in\mathbb Z$ satisfy $0\le p\le P$, and let $l,l'$ be control states. If the instruction at $l$ moves the memory head one cell right and continues at $l'$, then every guarded finite run from the configuration at $l'$ with state $st$, memory $M$, and head position $p+1$ to a configuration $c$ can be prefixed by that instruction: there is a guarded finite run from the configuration at $l$ with the same state and memory and head position $p$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: an oracle on four indices and Boolean words
a state $st$ with all 17 register values at most $B$
the instruction at $l$ is a right memory move to $l'$
guarded reachability from the specified successor configuration to $c$
replaced:
Let $K_0,B,P$ be natural numbers, let
$\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{Bool}$ be an
oracle, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Suppose a machine instruction at control state
$l$ moves the memory head one cell right and continues at $l'$. Let $st$ be a register
state whose 17 counters are all at most $B$, let the head position $p$ satisfy $0\le
p\le P$, and suppose $c$ is reachable from the configuration at $l'$ with the same
registers and memory and head position $p+1$, while maintaining the guard at every
earlier step. Then $c$ is reachable from the configuration at $l$ with the same
registers and memory and head position $p$, while maintaining that guard at every
earlier step.
